detail.description: Vocos 实例化由配置文件命名的类，而不限制可以命名哪个类。 vocos/pretrained.py 中的 instantiate_class 从配置中获取 class_path 值，将其拆分为模块和属性，使用 __import__ 导入模块，使用 getattr 解析属性，并将结果调用为 args_class(*args, **kwargs)，其中 kwargs 是配置自己的 init_args 映射。没有白名单限制点路径，因此配置可以命名任何可导入的可调用对象并提供调用它的参数。 Vocos.from_hparams 为每个 feature_extractor、backbone 和 head 条目实现此目的，而 Vocos.from_pretrained 通过远程文件实现此目的：它从调用者命名的 Hugging Face 存储库下载 config.yaml 并将其直接传递到 from_hparams。从用户无法控制的存储库加载模型，因此会在加载过程中执行存储库所有者选择的代码。下载权重的相邻 torch.load 是一个单独的问题，并且受到 PyTorch 版本的限制，默认weights_only为true，这使得该路径成为可到达的路径。
detail.kind: 使用外部可控制的输入来选择类或代码（不安全的反射）
detail.kind_en: 使用外部控制输入来选择类或代码（“不安全反射”）
detail.title: CVE-2026-79784漏洞

detail_original.description: Vocos instantiates a class named by a configuration file without restricting which class may be named. instantiate_class in vocos/pretrained.py takes the class_path value from the configuration, splits it into a module and an attribute, imports the module with __import__, resolves the attribute with getattr, and calls the result as args_class(*args, **kwargs) where kwargs is the config's own init_args mapping. No allowlist constrains the dotted path, so a configuration may name any importable callable and supply the arguments it is called with. Vocos.from_hparams reaches this for each of the feature_extractor, backbone and head entries, and Vocos.from_pretrained reaches it with a remote file: it downloads config.yaml from a caller-named Hugging Face repository and passes it straight to from_hparams. Loading a model from a repository the user does not control therefore executes code of the repository owner's choosing in the loading process. The neighbouring torch.load of the downloaded weights is a separate matter and is constrained on PyTorch releases that default weights_only to true, which leaves this path as the reachable one.
